name: @workspace/tool-ui-html-preview
description: The HTML Preview tool's component and definition (D14, docs/tools/specs/html-preview.md): the definition is the main export, the component loads when the tool is opened. The preview is the kit's sandboxed frame (@workspace/ui/framed-document) with a policy that lets nothing load, filled by the page with the nodes and constructed sheets of the logic package's check. Records into the tool history through its host.
